extracted.intended_audience: Rospatent staff, federal executive authorities, IP practitioners, policymakers and researchers interested in Russian IP administration and statistics
extracted.subtask_description: Extracting and reporting Rospatent's cooperation with federal authorities, the types of IP-related data provided, judicial/dispute-resolution metrics, regional inventive-activity statistics, and lists of outreach events (conferences/seminars) for 2017–2019. Focus is on administrative reporting and statistical indicators used to evaluate IP-office performance and inter-agency interaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provision of data regarding the objects for IP right protection
rubrics_metrics.description: Provision of data regarding the objects for IP right protection, data, and documents on disposal of IP rights. Specifically: provision of references on the results of an examination of the similarity degree between unregistered designations used for marking goods, and trademarks; on the homogeneity of products; on the use of any feature of the protected invention in any object, utility model, or industrial design; provision of data on the registration of a particular object of industrial property, the scope of provided protection, number, and date of granted protection, the validity of the title of protection, of the rights holders and/or on their representatives, as well as data on the contracts‘ registration on the exclusive ownership of the object of industrial property.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are the types of data Rospatent supplies to federal executive authorities upon request (listed in Table 3.1). Use when answering inter-agency inquiries about existence, scope, and legal status of IP rights and similarity/examination results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provision of information on the availability of the registered objects for IP rights protection
rubrics_metrics.description: Provision of information on the availability of the registered objects for IP rights protection, including: provision of data on interim measures in respect of the objects for IP rights protection; seizure of the objects for IP rights protection; withdrawal of the seizure from the objects for IP rights protection; provision of data and documents on disposal of IP rights.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used for enforcement and procedural coordination with law-enforcement and judicial bodies; provided upon request as part of cooperation with authorities (Table 3.1).

rubrics_metrics.name: Cooperation metrics: number of requests and subject of requests by authority
rubrics_metrics.description: For each federal executive authority, record the Number of requests and the Subject of requests (examples: 'Provision of data regarding the objects for IP right protection, data, and documents on disposal of IP rights' and 'Provision of information on the availability of the registered objects for IP rights protection'). The table shows counts by authority for 2017–2019 (e.g., Government of the Russian Federation, Ministry of Education and Science, Ministry of Defence, Federal Bailiff Service, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These counts measure the volume and subjects of inter-agency information exchange; useful to evaluate cooperation intensity and topics across years and authorities (see Table 3.1 totals and per-authority rows).

rubrics_metrics.name: Breakdown of results of intellectual activity by state customer
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown, by state customer, of the results of intellectual activity of military, special and dual use, registered in the Unified Register. Categories include patents of the Russian Federation for invention; patents for utility model; certificates of state registration of computer program; certificates of state registration of topographies of integrated circuits; certificates of state registration of databases; know-how; scientific works. The table lists counts under state contracts (e.g., under 41 state contracts: 4 patents of invention; 7 utility model patents; 3 computer program registrations; 34 topography registrations; 86 know-how).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to evaluate the output mix and IP protection instruments obtained under state contracts with specific state customers (e.g., Roscosmos, Ministry of Industry and Trade).

rubrics_metrics.name: Judicial consideration metrics for contesting Rospatent decisions (patent-law objects)
rubrics_metrics.description: For patent-law objects (Utility Models, Inventions, Industrial Designs), record: the total number of decisions made by Rospatent based on the results of consideration of objections; the number of decisions of Rospatent contested in court and adopted as a result of consideration of objections; the number of invalidated decisions of Rospatent in court; the number of decisions of Rospatent affirmed in court (presented for 2018 and 2019).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These four counts per object type are the core metrics for assessing how often Rospatent's decisions are contested and how courts treat them (Table 3.2). Useful for measuring decision quality and legal robustness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judicial consideration metrics for contesting Rospatent decisions (means of individualization)
rubrics_metrics.description: For means of individualization (Trademarks, Traditional Knowledge, Appellations of Origin), record the same four counts as above: total number of decisions made by Rospatent based on objections/applications; number contested in court; number invalidated in court; number affirmed in court (shown for 2018 and 2019).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Parallel judicial-review indicators for non-patent IP categories; enables comparison of contestation and court outcomes across types of individualization (Table 3.3).

rubrics_metrics.name: Judicial acts and cases metrics on contesting Rospatent actions/inaction
rubrics_metrics.description: Track, by object type (Patents, Trademarks, etc.), the Number of contested actions (inaction) of Rospatent; Number of actions (inaction) of Rospatent recognized as unlawful; and The number of decisions of Rospatent affirmed in court (for 2018 and 2019).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These metrics (Table 3.4) summarize formal judicial acts and their outcomes when Rospatent's procedural actions or omissions are challenged in court.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dispute resolution process metrics by court type and object
rubrics_metrics.description: For disputes concerning contracts, authorship and patent holder, infringement of exclusive rights (2019), record demand outcomes (Demands satisfied / Demands not satisfied) across court venues: Arbitration Court, General Court, Intellectual Property Court — broken down by object types (Trademarks, Inventions, Utility Models, Industrial Designs, Databases, International Registrations, Appellations of Origin, Computer programs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to evaluate where and how claims regarding IP ownership/infringement are resolved and the success rates across courts and object types (Table 3.5).

rubrics_metrics.name: Judicial acts metrics on early termination of trademark protection due to non-use
rubrics_metrics.description: For early termination of legal protection of trademarks due to non-use (2019), record demands satisfied / demands not satisfied in Intellectual Property Court and Other arbitration courts, separately for Trademarks and International registrations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enables assessment of how frequently non-use cancellation actions succeed and in which courts (Table 3.6 totals and court breakdown).

rubrics_metrics.name: Organization and conduct of conferences, seminars and round tables (outreach events log)
rubrics_metrics.description: Record the Name of the event, Date of the event, and Venue for conferences, seminars, round tables, webinars, master classes, training seminars and other outreach events organized or co-organized by Rospatent/FIPS in regions of the Russian Federation in 2019 (extensive list including event titles and venues).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This event log is used to document outreach, training, and cooperation activities across regions and stakeholder groups; useful as an activity / knowledge-transfer metric (see Table 3.8 and following listings).

rubrics_metrics.name: Analysis of inventive activity by federal districts and constituent entities (coefficient of inventive activity)
rubrics_metrics.description: Analysis by federal districts and constituent entities of the Russian Federation of inventive activity (excluding utility models), including a 'Coefficient of inventive activity' per region/entity (table header shown in Table 3.9).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regional inventive-activity coefficients are a statistical metric for comparing inventive output intensity across regions and federal districts; used in policy and regional analysis.
